description: Full Telegram round-trip with the target on Codex framework. Switches topic 2525 to codex-cli via /route, sends a conversational question, asserts the AGENT itself (not a sentinel/standby) replies within 90s. This is the scenario that catches the v1.0.0 bug where Codex sessions never called telegram-reply.sh because they never saw a relay instruction.

steps.text: test-driver-probe-PONG12: please reply with exactly the word PONG12 followed by the name of the framework you are running on. Keep it under 20 words. Do not run any tools.
